question: Please list the average number of prenatal weeks in 2018 for counties in Wisconsin where more than 5% of the employed population had commutes of 45-59 minutes in 2017.
sql:
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(n.Ave_Number_of_Prenatal_Wks), 2) AS avg_prenatal_weeks,
  COUNT(DISTINCT n.County_of_Residence_FIPS) AS num_counties
FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality` n
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT geo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE SUBSTR(geo_id, 1, 2) = '55' 
    AND employed_pop > 0 
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(commute_45_59_mins, employed_pop) * 100 > 5
) c ON n.County_of_Residence_FIPS = c.geo_id
WHERE n.Year = DATE('2018-01-01')
